title: scurrula cylindrica
intro: Scurrula cylindrica, commonly known as Scurrula cordata, is a species of flowering plant in the family Santalaceae. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains some of its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants. The health benefits of Scurrula cylindrica include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
